stages.target: open space directly in front of the robot's right shoulder
stages.affordance: empty air straight ahead at shoulder height, above the red carpet and short of the seated person's knees (center of the view, columns D-E)
stages.description: From the rest pose at the robot's side, swing the right hand forward and up in one smooth arc (roughly 35-45 cm forward and 40 cm up, as in the pointing demo), straightening the elbow so the hand ends straight ahead at shoulder height with the palm/hand tip pointing forward. Do not lift straight up first and do not push forward while the hand is still hanging low; combine up and forward together. Keep well clear of the seated person, the laptop and the standing person on the left.
stages.completion: The right arm is visibly straight and horizontal, hand tip out in front at shoulder height and entering the lower-center/right of the camera view pointing forward, not touching any person, chair or laptop.

stages.target: same spot in the air in front of the right shoulder
stages.affordance: empty air straight ahead at shoulder height
stages.description: Keep the right arm locked straight and level in front of the body for a few seconds without drifting up, down or sideways.
stages.completion: The straight right arm stays in the same position across consecutive frames, hand tip still at shoulder height directly in front, with no contact with people or objects.
